From d74a7566bef76b44416071fbb7e34f301eac8d98 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Matt Roper <matthew.d.roper@intel.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Nov 2019 08:44:12 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915/ehl: Update voltage level checks
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The bspec was recently updated with new cdclk -> voltage level tables to
accommodate the new 324/326.4 cdclk values.

Bspec: 21809
Fixes: 63c9dae71dc5 ("drm/i915/ehl: Add voltage level requirement table")
Cc: José Roberto de Souza <jose.souza@intel.com>
Cc: Vivek Kasireddy <vivek.kasireddy@intel.com>
Cc: Bob Paauwe <bob.j.paauwe@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Matt Roper <matthew.d.roper@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20191118164412.26216-1-matthew.d.roper@intel.com
Reviewed-by: José Roberto de Souza <jose.souza@intel.com>
(cherry picked from commit d147483884ed08ee6bb618ef610ee0329a27fda7)
Signed-off-by: Joonas Lahtinen <joonas.lahtinen@linux.intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_cdclk.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_cdclk.c
index 0caef2592a7e..ed8c7ce62119 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_cdclk.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_cdclk.c
@@ -1273,7 +1273,9 @@ static u8 icl_calc_voltage_level(int cdclk)
 
 static u8 ehl_calc_voltage_level(int cdclk)
 {
-	if (cdclk > 312000)
+	if (cdclk > 326400)
+		return 3;
+	else if (cdclk > 312000)
 		return 2;
 	else if (cdclk > 180000)
 		return 1;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_cdclk.c`**
   - The function `ehl_calc_voltage_level` was modified to update the voltage level checks based on new specifications.
   - The condition for returning a voltage level of 3 was changed from `cdclk > 312000` to `cdclk > 326400`.
   - An additional condition was added to return a voltage level of 2 for `cdclk` values greater than 312000.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The changes in `intel_cdclk.c` are directly related to updates in the bspec (specification document) that introduced new cdclk to voltage level mappings. The modifications ensure that the voltage level calculations align with the updated specifications for the new 324/326.4 cdclk values, thereby fixing the bug associated with voltage level requirements. The patch references a previous commit that added the initial voltage level requirement table, indicating that this update is a continuation of that work to refine the voltage level checks.

drm/i915/ehl: Update voltage level checks
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The bspec was recently updated with new cdclk -> voltage level tables to
accommodate the new 324/326.4 cdclk values.

Bspec: 21809
Fixes: 63c9dae71dc5 ("drm/i915/ehl: Add voltage level requirement table")
Cc: José Roberto de Souza <jose.souza@intel.com>
Cc: Vivek Kasireddy <vivek.kasireddy@intel.com>
Cc: Bob Paauwe <bob.j.paauwe@intel.com>

Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20191118164412.26216-1-matthew.d.roper@intel.com
Reviewed-by: José Roberto de Souza <jose.souza@intel.com>
(cherry picked from commit d147483884ed08ee6bb618ef610ee0329a27fda7)
Signed-off-by: Joonas Lahtinen <joonas.lahtinen@linux.intel.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by outdated voltage level checks in the `ehl_calc_voltage_level` function, which did not account for the new cdclk values (324/326.4) as specified in the updated bspec. This led to incorrect voltage level assignments for certain cdclk values, potentially affecting the performance and stability of the system.

Here is the patch:
 
 static u8 ehl_calc_voltage_level(int cdclk)
 {
-	if (cdclk > 312000)
+	if (cdclk > 326400)
+		return 3;
+	else if (cdclk > 312000)
 		return 2;
 	else if (cdclk > 180000)
 		return 1;
 	else
 		return 0;
 }
